snippet.title: Drift Splatter - Trailer | Arcade Roguelite Where Your Car Runs on Blood
snippet.description:
Your car runs on blood, and zombies have plenty of it. 

Drift Splatter is an arcade roguelite about smashing through endless hordes, drifting to refuel, and surviving random events that can swing a whole run and spin a ruthless roulette for unpredictable upgrades!

Free Demo On Steam!
